macros.name: Artifact
macros.doc: Inside a checklist of type Artifact, the \Artifact macro specifies an artifact.

macros.name: CheckListAddEntryOption
macros.doc: The \CheckListAddEntryOption{⟨option⟩}{⟨default⟩} macro declares a new ⟨option⟩ that can be used when defining checklist entries.

macros.name: CheckListAddStatus
macros.doc: The \CheckListAddStatus{⟨types⟩}{⟨status⟩}{⟨isclosed⟩}{⟨symbol⟩} macro declares a new ⟨status⟩ for a given comma-separated list of checklist ⟨types⟩.

macros.name: CheckListAddType
macros.doc: The \CheckListAddType{⟨type⟩}{⟨symbol⟩} adds a new checklist type with name ⟨type⟩ to the list of known checklist types.

macros.name: CheckListDateCompare
macros.doc: The \CheckListDateCompare{⟨date⟩}{⟨comp⟩}{⟨refdate⟩}{⟨iftrue⟩}{⟨iffalse⟩}{⟨iffail⟩} macro compares ⟨date⟩ against ⟨refdate⟩ using the operator ⟨comp⟩.

macros.name: CheckListDeclareLayout
macros.doc: The \CheckListDeclareLayout{⟨name⟩}{⟨fields⟩}{⟨begin⟩}{⟨end⟩} macro declares a new checklist layout with the given ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: CheckListDefaultLabel
macros.doc: This macro sets ⟨label⟩ as the label for the current entry, based on the default checklist counter.

macros.name: CheckListDefaultLayout
macros.doc: The \CheckListDefaultLayout{⟨layout⟩} macro sets the default layout for all CheckList environments that do not set the layout option explicitly.

macros.name: CheckListDefineFieldFormat
macros.doc: The \CheckListDefineFieldFormat{⟨layout⟩}{⟨field⟩}{⟨code⟩} macro defines the ⟨code⟩ to be used for displaying the given ⟨field⟩ (or fields) in a checklist of the given ⟨layout⟩.

macros.name: CheckListDisplayDeadline
macros.doc: This macro displays ⟨deadline⟩ depending on the given entry’s ⟨status⟩ and the current date.

macros.name: CheckListExtendLayout
macros.doc: The \CheckListExtendLayout{⟨name⟩}{⟨base⟩}{⟨fields⟩} macro declares a new checklist layout, ⟨name⟩, which inherits existing ⟨fields⟩ as well as the ⟨begin⟩ and ⟨end⟩ code from a given ⟨base⟩ layout.

macros.name: CheckListFilterClosed
macros.doc: This macro sets up a filter that hides all checklist entries whose status is closed.

macros.name: CheckListFilterDeadline
macros.doc: The \CheckListFilterDeadline[⟨types⟩]{⟨comp⟩}{⟨refdate⟩}{⟨filter-inv⟩} macro filters out all checklist entries whose deadline does not satisfy the comparison against ⟨refdate⟩ by operator ⟨comp⟩ (‘<’, ‘=’, ‘>’).

macros.name: CheckListFilterReset
macros.doc: The \CheckListFilterReset[⟨types⟩] macro resets the filters for all checklist types in the comma-separated list ⟨types⟩.

macros.name: CheckListFilterValue
macros.doc: The \CheckListFilterValue[⟨types⟩]{⟨field⟩}{⟨value⟩} macro filters out all checklist entries whose ⟨field⟩ is unequal ⟨value⟩, by using an \ifstrequal comparison.

macros.name: CheckListIfClosed
macros.doc: The \CheckListIfClosed{⟨status⟩}{⟨iftrue⟩}{⟨iffalse⟩} macro expands to ⟨iftrue⟩, if the ⟨status⟩ of an entry in the current checklist is a “closed” one (see the documentation for \CheckListAddStatus for details).

macros.name: CheckListSet
macros.doc: This macro takes a comma-separated ⟨options⟩ list and sets these options for all subsequent checklists.

macros.name: CheckListSetFilter
macros.doc: The \CheckListSetFilter[⟨types⟩]{⟨fields⟩}{⟨code⟩} macro defines a filter for the given ⟨fields⟩ of all types in the comma-separated list ⟨types⟩.

macros.name: CheckListStatusSymbol
macros.doc: The macro expands to the defined symbol for the given ⟨status⟩, i.e., the overlay between the checklist type’s base symbol and the entry status’ symbol.

macros.name: Goal
macros.doc: Inside a checklist of type Goal, the \Goal macro specifies a goal.

macros.name: Milestone
macros.doc: Inside a checklist of type Milestone, the \Milestone macro specifies a milestone.

macros.name: Task
macros.doc: Inside a checklist of type Task, the \Task macro specifies a task.

envs.name: CheckList
envs.doc: The CheckList[⟨options⟩]{⟨type⟩} environment declares a new checklist.
